mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a tight labor market, leading to higher wage growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a strong supply chain, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and consumer spending indicates a strong demand cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong demand (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 2.5% and an increase in the consumer price index above 2.5% indicates an inflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in inflationary periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in payroll employment above 150,000 and a decline in the unemployment rate below 4% indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1,000,000 and a decline in consumer spending below $500,000,000,000 indicates a weak demand cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak demand (t-test p > 0.05).
